transcript.text: We use Aadhaar-based E-Sign for all vendor NDAs. Can Smallest AI support that?
Hello, this is the Legal Coordination Assistant for Smallest AI. I can help you with NDAs, MSAs, or vendor registration. How can I assist you today?
What signatory details do we need from your side for E-Sign?
Yes, we absolutely support Aadhaar-based E-Sign for Indian banking clients. You can send the NDA to legal@smallest.ai
For E-Sign, we typically require the signatory's Aadhaar number, mobile number, and a One-Time Password (OTP). We can also use a DocuSign or Adobe Sign link if that works better for your team.
